verses.text: A praise psalm by David. I’ll lift you high, my God and King. I’ll praise your name forever and ever.
I’ll praise you every day. I’ll lift up your name forever and ever.
The LORD is great and deserves great praise! There’s no getting to the bottom of his greatness.
One generation will tell the next about your works and speak of the mighty things you’ve done.
I’ll think deeply about your glorious majesty and honor and the wonders you’ve done.
People will talk about the power behind your awesome acts, and I’ll tell them how great you are.
They’ll tell the stories of your great goodness and sing about your righteousness.
The LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to get angry and full of faithful love.
The LORD is good to everyone. His tender mercy covers everything he’s made.
Everything you’ve made will thank you, LORD. Your holy people will lift you high.
They’ll talk about your kingdom’s glory and tell people about your power,
so everyone will know the mighty things you’ve done and the glorious majesty of your kingdom.
Your kingdom lasts forever. Your rule lasts through every generation. The LORD is faithful in everything he says and loving in everything he does.
The LORD holds up everyone who falls and lifts up everyone bowed down.
All eyes look to you and wait. You give them their food at the right time.
You open your hand and satisfy what every living thing needs.
The LORD is righteous in every way and gracious in everything he does.
The LORD is close to everyone who calls on him, everyone who calls on him in truth.
He’ll fulfill what the people who fear him long for. He’ll hear them cry out and save them.
The LORD watches over everyone who loves him, but he’ll destroy all the wicked.
I’ll praise the LORD out loud. Let every living person bless his holy name forever and ever.
